# 北疆催化专属WORLD：自建封建双方与继承人，借用北疆两县并迁都；准备完成后才创建局势。
# root为报告者；输出actor、recipient、tca_fc_test_county，复用和约测试夹具；整局用后丢弃。
tca_frontier_catalyst_test_prepare_effect = {
    tca_treaty_test_prepare_effect = yes
    title:c_lingzhou = { random_neighboring_county = { limit = { exists = holder } save_scope_as = tca_fc_test_county } }
    create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = granted save_scope_as = tca_fc_test_grant }
    scope:tca_fc_test_county = { change_title_holder = { holder = scope:actor change = scope:tca_fc_test_grant government_base = scope:tca_treaty_test_base take_baronies = yes } }
    title:c_lingzhou = { change_title_holder = { holder = scope:recipient change = scope:tca_fc_test_grant government_base = scope:tca_treaty_test_base take_baronies = yes } }
    resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_fc_test_grant
    scope:actor = { tca_treaty_test_independent_effect = yes set_realm_capital = scope:tca_fc_test_county add_prestige = 10000 }
    scope:recipient = { tca_treaty_test_independent_effect = yes set_realm_capital = title:c_lingzhou }
}
